meta.description: Agent Skills distilled from GitHub repos by skill-anything. Each bundle ships with a reproducible blind-eval audit trail.

skills.name: openjudge
skills.description: OpenJudge (py-openjudge) — LLM-as-judge evaluation framework: grader selection, score-scale normalization, rubric workflows, agent trajectory evaluation.
skills.score_caveat: iter-2 best (kept); iter-3 regressed to 0.7792 (discarded). Single-grader run (K=1), trajectory signal unavailable. See eval-manifest.json -> honest_caveats.
skills.why_still_publish: Skill passes validate_skill.py, wins 12/12 tasks on quality against the no-Skill baseline (iter-2, quality-only), and the audit trail is public. Beta = the quality signal is real; the cost/trajectory telemetry is not yet.

skills.name: openjudge-index
skills.description: Routing + debiasing (rm-gallery -> py-openjudge, Reward -> Grader). Read this first.

skills.name: openjudge-grader-selection
skills.description: Decision tree: LLMGrader vs FunctionGrader vs AgenticGrader; score-scale map (1-3 vs 1-5 vs binary); structured_model traps.

skills.name: openjudge-rubric-workflow
skills.description: Three-path rubric generation; GradingRunner batch eval; IterativeRubricsGenerator silent-empty-rubric gotcha.

skills.name: openjudge-agent-eval
skills.description: TrajectoryGrader (1-3) vs ToolCallAccuracyGrader (1-5) with explicit normalization formulas. AgenticGrader v0.2.0 pre-built agent requirement.
